selection_boundary: Mainz AGS 07315000, BKG-derived Gemeindegrenzen_2026 via Esri Germany; reference 31.12.2025; used only for spatial selection
processing: OSM area facilities converted to interior representative points. Land-use polygons clipped to selection boundary; overlapping land-use polygons retained. EPSG:25832 used for areas and distances. One feature per selected OSM object; not a deduplicated register of establishments.
